title: Conducting a systematic review
description: Learn how to conduct a systematic review through this guide. We'll cover how to form your question, deciding where to search, as well as managing and reporting on your results.

title: Copyright essentials for teaching
description: This guide introduces the basics of copyright, including using others' work correctly and getting permission. You'll learn how to safely use literary works, images, and video in your teaching while adhering to copyright law.

title: Copyright for students: who owns what?
description: Understand what copyright is and what it means for your as a student by going through this interactive guide.

title: Copyright for teaching materials: can I use it?
description: This short online guide can help you determine whether you can use different types of material in your teaching, without breaching copyright law.

title: Copyright guidance at The University of Manchester
description: This guide will help you to find out how copyright affects your work, research and study here at the University of Manchester.

title: Critical appraisal for medicine and health sciences
description: This guide explores the critical appraisal process, the types of study you will encounter, and the areas to concentrate on when appraising a research article.

title: Getting started searching for business data and literature
description: There are various types of business data and literature you can access for free using the University of Manchester Library. Explore where you can find them through this guide.

title: Getting started with Capital IQ Pro
description: Learn how to find worldwide private company data through this guide to Capital IQ Pro.

title: Getting started with EndNote Desktop
description: Get to grips with EndNote Desktop through this guide, which introduces how to collect, manage, and format references in order to cite and reference sources.

title: Getting started with EndNote Online
description: If you're wanting to use EndNote Online, this guide will show you have to collect, manage, and format references in order to cite and reference sources.

title: Getting started with searching Fame
description: This guide introduces the Fame business database for researching companies in the United Kingdom and Republic of Ireland.

title: Glossary of advanced searching
description: This post shows the meaning of various terms used in the advanced searching of information.

title: Library support for advanced searching
description: This set of resources will show you introduce you to medical and health sciences databases. It will help you with searching, refining and your results as well as accessing further support from experts.

title: Library support for business data
description: The resources in this guide will help you get started researching business data.

title: Library support for digital skills
description: Identify areas to further develop your digital capabilities through this interactive guide. We cover the digital capabilities framework and how to get started with LinkedIn Learning's suite of expert-led online courses.

title: Library support for referencing
description: Discover all the resources and support on referencing available to you from the Library through this guide. You can find guidance on how to reference different types of sources, different referencing styles, and using referencing software.

title: Microsoft 365 Fundamentals Certification
description: The University of Manchester provides students with the opportunity to study for and attain a Microsoft 365 Fundamentals Certification free of charge. This guide contains all of the information you'll need to prepare and take an exam.

title: Preparing to use Eventus and converting the results
description: Learn to prepare the data you need to run an event study query in Eventus through this guide. We also consider how you can convert the data you retrieve into a more usable format using SPSS or SAS.

title: Searching and exporting your results from Ovid
description: This guide will take you through how to search Ovid effectively including using Medical Subject Headings, exporting your results for de-duplication and sharing your search strategy to request further help and support.

title: Searching effectively
description: This guide introduces key strategies for refining search results, including keyword planning, Boolean operators, and advanced techniques for web and database searches. It also highlights how to evaluate sources for reliability and relevance, helping you to find trustworthy, high-quality information efficiently.

title: Searching systematically
description: In this guide you will explore four databases which will help you to find and refine your results to helping you through the process of searching systematically.

title: Systematic review: organising your keywords and subject terms
description: In this post we will explore the keywords and subject headings that you will use to support the early scoping exercises and subsequent literature reviews. We will also explore how MeSH and MeSH trees can help you to  collect, organise and present your search terms.

title: Using Bloomberg Professional
